newsitem.title: USA: Clinton calls rise in US stocks "astonishing fact".
newsitem.headline: Clinton calls rise in US stocks "astonishing fact".

text.p: President Bill Clinton said on Wednesday that the overall rally in U.S. stock markets in recent years was "an astonishing fact."
"When I took office, the market was 3,200. So it's gone up at an unprecedented rate to unprecedented heights," he said at a news conference in reply to a question about the current market level.
"But that increase has been accompanied by a very brisk growth in our economy and strong growth in productivity," he said.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 63 points on the day at 8,251 at the time of Clinton's remark.
